newsitem.title: FRANCE: European Commission leader visits Algeria.
newsitem.headline: European Commission leader visits Algeria.

text.p: European Commission Vice-President Manuel Marin arrived in Algeria on Sunday for a two-day visit to examine a proposed partnership agreement between Algeria and the European Union, the Algerian News Agency APS said.
"My visit aims...at appraising the way we have to go to finalise negotiations over partnership accords," APS quoted him as saying on his arrival.

Marin, who is also European Commissioner for cooperation with South Mediterranean countries, would discuss how to implement an association and free trade accord between the European Union and Algeria.
APS said the go-ahead had been given for this agreement last June.
"We will have, in the first quarter of 1997, a precise idea about the date the accord will become effective," he said.
Marin also said that a financial convention estimated at 125 million ECUs ($156 million) was to be signed soon between the two parties to back Algeria's programme of structural adjustment.
